record_title: A local-lemma criterion for sequential edge orderings in bipartite graphs
limitations: A sufficient local-lemma criterion and a complete degree-5 bipartite corollary, not a solution for arbitrary 5-regular graphs or the remaining degrees 3 and 4. The full text of the directly relevant 2026 preprint was not inspected, so an unindexed body-only remark or very recent parallel work remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
